title: UBL Kernel v1.0 — Runnable Public-Contract Reference
description:
Runnable, independent Python illustration of the published Universal Binary Language Kernel v1.0 contract. This archive includes an editable synthetic temperature example, a raw-atom CLI, 20 standard-library tests, the frozen public contract and review documents. It is an archive update, not a new kernel version or a release of the private compiler/RTL.

Requires Python 3.11+ with no additional packages. After extracting the ZIP, open a terminal in its folder and run python -m conformance.demo. Run the tests with python -m unittest discover -s conformance -p 'test_*.py' -v. Change readings with python -m conformance.demo --readings 69 70 71 --threshold 71. The default alarm ledger is [70,75,75,125]; repeated occurrences and escaped reserved literals are retained.

Public CI passes 20 tests on Python 3.11 and 3.13. These tests concern this public Python subset, not the private cross-runtime suite or historical formal/hardware results. Complete framing/patch behavior, normative EventID initialization, capacity overflow, physical timing, energy and power-loss durability are not established. See conformance/GAPS.md. No architectural advantage or novelty is claimed by this demo.

Public repository materials are released under CC BY 4.0 at the author's request. The original version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23845298 remains the separate October 2026 documentation baseline; do not treat that archived ZIP as containing this runnable example.
